en.name: Loyara Loyalty & Rewards
en.subtitle: Points, referrals & VIP tiers. Flat price, unlimited orders
en.intro: Points, VIP tiers & referrals for one flat monthly price — unlimited orders, no overage fees. Ever.
en.details: Loyara is the flat-price loyalty program for Shopify. Customers earn points on every order and redeem them for discounts from a fast storefront widget — with VIP tiers, referrals, birthday bonuses and points expiry all included on one plan. No order-count tiers, no overage fees: your bill never changes as you grow. Switching from another loyalty app? A five-minute CSV import brings every member's point balance with you — nobody loses a point.
features: Flat monthly price, unlimited orders — no per-order or overage fees
Points, VIP tiers, referrals & birthday bonuses — all included, nothing gated
Five-minute CSV migration — your customers keep every point
Fast widget: no external scripts, no layout shift, tiny storefront footprint
en.titleTag: Loyara — flat-price Shopify loyalty & rewards program
en.metaDescription: A Shopify loyalty program for one flat monthly price with unlimited orders — points, VIP tiers, referrals, 5-minute migration. No order-count or overage fees.
